Dream 2026-11-22 linked 9 vignettes from 6 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "Our examples should show how SRS should be used." (Our examples should show how SRS should be used)
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "It should be standard for any work." (All problems and domains evolve from stories (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "this process should be dogfooding itself" (The process dogfoods itself (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-29 · touches · "Consider this dogfooding+ This is a tech demo. How would srs add value?" (Vignette 2026-10-29: helping knowledge gathering with SRS)
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "in both there is a set of underlying parts that we use as semantic infrastructure." (A way of working is emerging: shared semantic infrastructure under domains and essays, comparing parents, siblings and children, cloning a domain, and zoomability (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "SRS provides a semantic framework, then we pull in the words." (SRS provides a semantic framework, then we pull in the words: why AI guidance, blueprints and protocols are in the core (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-06 · touches · "SRS is the tool for the ecosystem. The Editor is a proof of concept." (Local AI is the ecosystem and SRS is its tool; the real Mozilla pitch is SRS, and the editor is a front door showing tools without vendor lock-in (2026-11-06))
- 2026-11-07 · touches · "Keeping the right level of intelligence at the right level we can make the local model model possible." (Nearby AI needs communities capable of maintenance: muDemocracy for governing, SRS and the relay for owning data, the essay editor for safe individual use; "dumb AI" is the right level of intelligence in the right place, "cybernetic AI" is fractal feedback, VSM (2026-11-07))
- 2026-11-22 · touches · "identify potential patterns of working with srs that allows it to be used well" (Vignette 2026-11-22: SRS must work well for humans and agents; where do their needs differ and conflict)
